correctness.rationale: Stationary cumulant formulas follow from independent exponentially sampled compound-Poisson excursions and converge for 0<=c<1 with E[J^3]<infinity. The generator gives exact triangular first/second centered-moment semigroup equations; multiplying by stationary centered powers gives a closed chronological contrast. Direct algebra factors the coefficient into a strictly increasing quadratic in c, with boundary 2(v-r^2), establishing the iff threshold and all-lag sign. Exact rational code independently reconstructs moments for 64 parameter combinations and both positive-support covariance twins. The c=0 repeated-eigenvalue limit is explicit.

value.rationale: The global sign reversal of a natural third-degree time-order statistic reveals temporal irreversibility features concealed by all second-order observations. The threshold is controlled by the normalized third raw input moment and the influx/reset rate ratio, not the second input moment; two strictly positive jump laws demonstrate opposite temporal arrows at identical mean, variance and full covariance. This sharp quantitative transport-memory discrimination is a motivated structural result rather than an arbitrary finite-table calculation.
